title.narrative: Tourism COVID-19 Response Facility

description.narrative: The outcome of the support will be to: preserve the contribution of the tourism sector towards Ugandas socio-economic development, which is major source of employment, production, skill development and inclusive growth of the economy. Tourism sits at the heart of the economic development of Uganda and indeed the world at large. With multiplier effect on many the other sectors of the economy like agriculture; tourism is a key driver of job creation, innovation, and growth in many countries.
